theme_central: The covenant (mithaq) between Allah and His creatures: believing the message, drawing lessons from the history of the Children of Israel, and living by the Law that flows from it.
sources_note: Ring (chiastic) structure of 9 sections, corroborated by an English-language structural analysis (academia.edu, Structural Analysis) and a French-language source (la-recherche-du-savoir.fr): the sections mirror each other (1↔9, 2↔8, 3↔7, 4↔6) around the central pivot (142-152, the change of Qibla). The fine detail of the legislative block 178-253 still needs verse-by-verse verification before production use.

branches.title: Faith and disbelief
branches.resume: Introduction mirroring the conclusion (285-286): believers, disbelievers, hypocrites.

children.t: The Book, guidance for the God-conscious; description of believers and disbelievers
The hypocrites, parables of fire and rain

branches.title: Creation, Adam
branches.resume: The Oneness of the Creator, the challenge of the Qur'an, Adam and stewardship on earth.

children.t: Oneness of the Creator, challenge to produce a similar surah
Adam, stewardship on earth, the fall

branches.title: The Children of Israel
branches.resume: Recalling the favours granted to the Children of Israel and their repeated rebellions.

children.t: Favours recalled, the golden calf, the sacrificed cow
Hardening of the heart, rejection of messengers, the magic at Babel

branches.title: Ibrahim, the Kaaba
branches.resume: Warning against hostile People of the Book; Ibrahim and Isma'il build the Kaaba.

children.t: Warning against the People of the Book, exclusive merit claimed by each group
Ibrahim and Isma'il build the Kaaba, the Milla of Ibrahim

branches.title: The change of Qibla (central pivot)
branches.resume: The direction of prayer changes toward the Kaaba; unity of the community.

children.t: New direction of prayer
The Kaaba as the unity of the community, remembrance of Allah

branches.title: Trials, true piety
branches.resume: Patience in trial; al-birr, true piety, as opposed to mere formalism.

children.t: Patience and prayer as help in times of trial
Al-birr (true piety) defined, beyond formal ritual

branches.title: Laws of the community
branches.resume: A dense legislative block: retaliation, wills, fasting, fighting, pilgrimage, marriage, divorce.

children.t: The law of retaliation (qisas)
The will (wasiyya)
The fast of the month of Ramadan
Not to unlawfully appropriate the property of others
Defensive fighting (qital)
The pilgrimage (hajj and umra)
Contrast between good and evil, prohibition of wine and games of chance
Marriage, divorce, breastfeeding, waiting periods
Fighting for the cause of Allah, the account of Talut, Jalut and Dawud

branches.title: Spending, charity
branches.resume: Charity, Ayat al-Kursi, spending in the path of Allah, the prohibition of riba, debt contracts.

children.t: Charity, Ayat al-Kursi, the resurrection shown to Ibrahim
Spending in the path of Allah (infaq)
Prohibition of riba (usurious interest)
Written debt contracts, the role of witnesses (the longest verse in the Qur'an)
Everything in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah

branches.title: Conclusion
branches.resume: Collective profession of faith and final supplication, echoing the opening.

children.t: The Messenger and the believers believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers
Final supplication: "Our Lord, do not burden us beyond what we can bear"
